session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
Tired. Like I'm stuck in the same place, trying to move forward but not making any progress.
I can see how frustrating that must feel. It’s important to remember that change doesn’t always happen quickly, but it’s still happening in small ways.
Yeah, but sometimes I feel like those small ways aren’t enough. Like I’m just spinning my wheels and nothing changes.
It’s easy to feel that way when progress feels invisible. But maybe we can look at what’s actually changing, even if it’s not obvious.
I don’t know what to look for. Everything feels the same. I can’t even get out of bed without feeling like I’m failing.
That sounds really heavy. I want to help you find something that feels manageable, even if it’s just one small step.
I don’t know what that would be. I feel like I’m broken and nothing I do matters.
I hear how overwhelming that feels. Maybe we can start by noticing what feels even slightly possible, even if it’s just taking a breath or sitting up.
I don’t know if that’s possible. I feel like I can’t even breathe without thinking about how much I’ve failed.
That’s a lot to carry. Let’s try to focus on what’s happening right now, without judgment—just noticing what’s present without trying to fix it.
I don’t know how to do that. Every time I try, I just end up thinking about how bad things are.
It’s okay to feel that way. Sometimes our minds get stuck in the same place, but maybe we can gently guide them back to the present without pushing too hard.
I don’t know how to stop my mind from going there. It’s like it’s on autopilot, and I can’t even control it.
It’s hard to feel like you’re not in control. But even when it feels like autopilot, there’s still a part of you that can choose to notice what’s happening without getting pulled into it.
I don’t know if I can even try. It feels like I’m fighting a battle I can’t win.
That’s a heavy feeling to carry. It’s okay to feel like you’re not winning—sometimes the first step is just acknowledging that you’re still trying.
Yeah, I guess I am still trying. But it feels like I’m just trying harder and failing more.
It’s understandable to feel that way when the effort doesn’t match the outcome. But maybe the effort itself is still valuable, even if it doesn’t look like progress.
I don’t know if effort even matters anymore. I feel like no matter what I do, it’s just another failure.
